About the icon displayed when using skills--#1 When an Item Skill is used in battle, an icon showing its effects is displayed. Here are the types of icons shown: Recover Health Gauge Recover Ki Gauge Recover Health and Ki Gauges Suppress Ki consumption Attack Power Up Defensive Power Up Attack Power Up, but loss of control

Choosing Skills: To use the skills you have obtained, you must set them up in the custom tray. You can set up to 7 skills in the custom tray.
